_doc: Trade routes to the settlements of the world (Systems/Trade.cs). A people at minStanding or better will take a route; the council pays openCost + openPerDay per day of road to fit out the caravan. Each trip (there and back, plus turnaroundDays, plus the season's march days both ways) sells up to load + loadPerHundred per 100 people of the export, keeping keepShare of its market target at home, at exportPrice times base (wantedPrice if the people want it), and buys back the import at importPrice times base while the market is short of it. Every caravan that gets through raises standing; raid odds rise with each living menace near the road. routes: how many the town may run at each charter tier. wagons: a route's caravan grows to this many wagons, each past the first carrying wagonLoad more, for wagonCost gold each.

sky._doc: The sky dock's airship on trade runs (Systems/Skyship.cs). Any known people at minStanding or better will let it moor; no route needed. It flies the hold (hold + holdPerHundred per 100 people, at most holdMax) of one good the town can spare (above keepShare of its target) there and back in speed days per day of road plus turnaround, for fitOut + fitOutPerDay a day aloft. Cargo sells at sellPrice times base (wantedPrice if they want it), plus farPremium per ring out, leaned by up to spread per people and good; every glut units sold there lately halve the price, glutFade of it clearing a day. Home it brings their good the town is shortest of, bought at buyPrice while the market holds under bringBelow of target. stormStep: the chance the weather at the far port (by its step, fair to tempest; weather.json) holds it stormDays longer, once a run. ambush per whole flying host (passage.json fliers) near the far end, up to ambushMax; ambushLoss of the cargo is cut loose. At a people with a high tower (a mooring tower project in neighbours.json, or a cloud-ledge site) it turns round in towerTurnaround days, sells for towerPremium more and meets towerAmbush of the fliers. The stand-in mayor sends a run at most every standInEvery days when it clears standInProfit.
